schema_note: Two levels: milestone -> task. Later milestones (M5+) are coarse-grained and get split at milestone start. Cross-cutting criteria (GC-07, GC-08, GC-10, GC-11, GC-13) re-verified at every milestone boundary via evals/run.sh.

milestones.name: Foundation: Expo scaffold, tokens, supabase client, migration 0001
Lesson core — first usable app (→ Gate D device install)
Content build-out: 5 domain lanes + exam register (Gate 0 before m5.6 ratchet)
Sync + leaderboard vs local Supabase (→ Gate A hosted)
Feynman grading live (→ Gate B key + deploy)
Juice, a11y, onboarding, final device (→ Gate C checklist)
